source.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
source.author: dotcoma

title.zh: Signal隐私：限制操作系统AI读取消息
title.en: Signal Privacy: Blocking OS AI From Reading Messages

excerpt.zh: Signal隐私保护将限制iOS 27及部分Android设备上的操作系统AI读取聊天画面，但截图防护无法覆盖所有数据访问路径。
excerpt.en: Signal privacy protections will limit operating-system AI access to chat screens on iOS 27 and some Android devices, but cannot cover every route to app data.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Signal正在加强对操作系统AI代理读取聊天内容的防护。该公司表示，iOS 27上将阻止应用内截图；在能够检测到AI助手试图读取屏幕的Android设备上，也会采取限制措施。
text.en: Signal is tightening protections against operating-system AI agents reading chats. The company says it will block in-app screenshots on iOS 27 and take steps to restrict access on Android devices where it can detect an AI assistant trying to read the screen.

text.zh: Signal隐私面临应用之外的数据访问
text.en: Signal privacy and access beyond the app

text.zh: Signal的担忧并非加密协议本身被破解，而是系统级助手为了响应用户请求而读取屏幕内容，并可能将数据交给本地数据库或远程服务器处理。一旦信息离开Signal的控制范围，应用的端到端加密就无法单独保证这些额外访问环节的隐私。
text.en: Signal’s concern is not that its encryption protocol has been broken. Rather, system-level assistants may read screen contents to respond to requests and pass that data to a local database or remote server. Once information leaves Signal’s control, end-to-end encryption alone cannot protect these additional access paths.

text.zh: 这些措施并不覆盖所有设备，也无法阻止代理通过文件系统等其他途径读取已存于设备上的内容。Signal指出，Android设备和厂商版本各异，检测能力有限；在macOS上，它也缺少可靠阻止截图的工具。Android上检测到此类访问时，Signal会自动启用“屏幕安全”设置；希望保留截图功能的用户可以在应用设置中关闭保护，但聊天内容可能因此暴露给AI代理。
text.en: The measures do not cover every device, nor can they prevent agents from reaching content already on a device through other routes, such as filesystem access. Signal says Android versions and manufacturers vary, limiting detection; on macOS, it lacks a reliable way to block screenshots. When this kind of access is detected on Android, Signal automatically enables its Screen Security setting. Users can disable the protection in the app to retain screenshots, but doing so may expose chat content to AI agents.

text.zh: Signal呼吁Apple、Google和Microsoft提供清晰文档，以及开发者易于使用的退出AI数据访问与处理选项，涵盖屏幕、文件、通知和系统接口。关键问题仍是操作系统厂商能否提供有效且不损害应用核心体验的标准化控制；在此之前，Signal的屏幕防护只能降低部分风险，不能构成全面保证。
text.en: Signal is calling on Apple, Google, and Microsoft to provide clear documentation and an accessible way for developers to opt out of AI data access and processing across screens, files, notifications, and system interfaces. The key open question is whether operating-system makers will offer standardized controls that work without undermining an app’s core utility. Until then, Signal’s screen protections can reduce some risks, but they are not a comprehensive guarantee.
